arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

Please find below the Acme Q1 market data information you requested:

--

2026-01-06,acme_corp,category_share_protein_bars,18.4%,US_total,Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull,share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset,high

2026-02-03,acme_corp,category_share_protein_bars,18.6%,US_total,Nielsen scanner Feb pull,share holding — Verdant flat — see analyst note,high
2026-02-08,acme_corp,retail_velocity_protein_bar_sku,4.9 units/store/week,US_total,IRI scan,uptick — Q1 promo driving trial,high

2026-02-22,acme_corp,share_of_voice_digital,33% of category SOV,US_total,Pathmatics digital ad scrape,leading category — Verdant at 24%,high

2026-03-08,acme_corp,category_share_protein_bars,18.9%,US_total,Nielsen scanner March pull,share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down,high
2026-03-18,acme_corp,retail_velocity_protein_bar_sku,5.1 units/store/week,US_total,IRI scan,best Q1 reading — momentum continues,high
2026-03-25,acme_corp,regional_momentum_northeast,+9% YoY,US_northeast,Acme syndicated dashboard,steady — no notable competitive shifts,high
2026-03-30,acme_corp,share_of_voice_digital,34% of category SOV,US_total,Pathmatics digital ad scrape,steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2,high

Let me know if you need anything further.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
